privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introLead: At Qore, safeguarding your venue data and your diners' privacy is foundational to everything we build. This Privacy Policy describes how Qore Technologies ('Qore', 'we', 'us') collects, uses, processes, and protects your information.
privacy.highlight1Desc: We never sell, monetize, or broker personal information of venue owners or diners.
privacy.highlight2Desc: Payment processing is handled directly by Stripe. Qore never stores or has access to full payment card numbers or CVVs.
privacy.highlight3Desc: You retain full control. Access, export, or permanently delete your data by emailing privacy@useqore.app.
privacy.sec1Title: 1. Who We Are & Scope of this Policy
privacy.sec1Content: Qore Technologies operates the cloud hospitality platform at useqore.app. In providing our services, Qore acts as a Data Controller for our registered venue owners, and as a Data Processor on behalf of venue operators for guest orders and table sessions. The venue operator remains the Data Controller for their end customers' dining records.
privacy.sec2B2BContent: When you register a venue, we collect business name, representative full name, business email, phone number, billing address, tax/VAT ID, and staff access PINs for Kitchen Display Systems.
privacy.sec2B2CContent: When guests scan a table QR code, we process table session tokens, optional guest nicknames (used exclusively to display who ordered which dish in the shared table cart), items ordered, dietary notes, and optional post-meal ratings.
privacy.sec2DeviceContent: We log IP addresses, browser user-agents, device screen resolution, and error telemetry strictly for security, rate limiting, DDoS mitigation, and system health.
privacy.sec3Content: We process data solely to: (i) synchronize real-time shared table carts between diners via WebSockets; (ii) route orders to kitchen display terminals; (iii) facilitate itemized and split-bill payment transactions; (iv) manage table bookings; and (v) comply with statutory accounting and tax regulations.
privacy.sec4Content: All credit card, debit card, Apple Pay, and Google Pay transactions are processed securely through Stripe, Inc. and its EU operating affiliates. Qore is PCI-DSS compliant via Stripe Elements and never touches, transmits, or stores primary account numbers (PAN) or security codes. Stripe's processing is governed by Stripe's Privacy Policy at stripe.com/privacy.
privacy.sec5Content: We use strictly necessary session cookies for authentication (NextAuth), CSRF protection, locale preference (NEXT_LOCALE), and theme persistence. Optional analytical telemetry is activated only upon your explicit consent via our cookie banner. You can review or modify your cookie choices at any time using the Cookie Settings link in the website footer.
privacy.sec6Content: We process personal data under GDPR Article 6 pursuant to: (a) Performance of a Contract (Art. 6(1)(b)) to deliver dining and SaaS services; (b) Legitimate Interests (Art. 6(1)(f)) for platform security and fraud prevention; (c) Compliance with Legal Obligations (Art. 6(1)(c)) for tax and invoicing; and (d) Consent (Art. 6(1)(a)) for optional cookies.
privacy.sec7Content: We work with trusted infrastructure providers bound by Data Processing Agreements (DPAs): Stripe (payment gateway), cloud server hosting (EU data centers), and transactional email delivery. We do not transfer personal data outside the EEA without adequate safeguards such as Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs).
privacy.sec8Content: Guest table sessions and temporary carts expire automatically after the table bill is settled. Venue account records are retained while your subscription is active, and accounting records are kept for the statutory period (up to 10 years). All data in transit is encrypted using TLS 1.3.
privacy.sec9Title: 9. Your Rights Under GDPR & International Laws
privacy.sec9Content: Under EU Regulation 2016/679 (GDPR), you possess: (i) Right of Access; (ii) Right to Rectification; (iii) Right to Erasure ('Right to be Forgotten'); (iv) Right to Restrict Processing; (v) Right to Data Portability; and (vi) Right to Object. To exercise any right, contact our Data Protection Office at privacy@useqore.app.
privacy.sec10Content: For questions regarding this policy or to submit a data subject request, write to privacy@useqore.app or Qore Technologies Legal, support@useqore.app.

about.title: The operating system for modern hospitality
about.subtitle: We believe dining out should be about conversation, great food, and atmosphere — not waving down busy servers for the check or struggling with slow PDF menus.
about.storyText1: Every week, millions of diners scan restaurant QR codes only to be confronted with unreadable PDF files that crawl over patio Wi-Fi. When the meal ends, dividing the check between four friends turns into ten awkward minutes of mental arithmetic, receipt recalculation, and stressed servers carrying multiple card terminals.
about.storyText2: We built Qore to solve this friction: an instant, collaborative table experience under one second, real-time shared carts, painless split payments, and AI-driven kitchen efficiency that lifts average order value while cutting routine staff workload.

stats.stat1Desc: No mobile app download. Server-rendered instant web interface on every phone.
stats.stat2Desc: Contextual AI pairings and appetizing category navigation lift diner spend.
stats.stat3Desc: Zero third-party ad tracking. Diners order without mandatory account creation.

about.pillar1Desc: No slow SPAs or battery-draining bundles. Menus render in under 800 milliseconds even on congested guest Wi-Fi.
about.pillar2Desc: Dining is communal. Everyone at the same table sees a live shared cart and can split the bill in two effortless taps.
about.pillar3Desc: Our Kitchen Display System (KDS) and 86 stop-list eliminate running back and forth, letting servers focus on true hospitality.
about.pillar4Desc: Core digital dining tools are free forever. Only high-compute AI and enterprise analytics require a paid plan.

contact.faq1Q: How quickly can my restaurant go live with Qore?
contact.faq1A: Most venues go live in less than an hour. Create your categories, add dishes with photos, and download your printable table QR codes directly from the dashboard.
contact.faq2Q: Do diners need to download an application from the App Store?
contact.faq2A: No! Diners simply point their phone camera at the table QR code. The menu opens immediately in their mobile browser with instant load times.
contact.faq3A: All digital payments and subscriptions are processed securely through Stripe. Guests can pay with credit card, Apple Pay, or Google Pay directly on their phones.
contact.faq4Q: Can I change or cancel my subscription at any time?
contact.faq4A: Yes, you can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your subscription at any time in your Venue Settings. There are no lock-in contracts or cancellation penalties.
